title: OmniTwin Foundry activation V1 expanded PostgreSQL catalog manifest
description: Strict machine-readable shape for the fully expanded PostgreSQL 16 catalog contract. Schema validation is necessary but not sufficient: acceptance MUST also run the mandatory semantic verifier defined by the companion format contract, after an authenticated bootstrap/review policy independently pins and validates that verifier's identity and digest. A verifier selected only by the manifest under review cannot authorize that manifest. Array order is normative: JSON Schema uniqueItems catches exact duplicate values, while that verifier enforces stable-key uniqueness, unsigned UTF-8 sorting, semantic ordinal order and ordinal continuity. File-level canonical UTF-8/JCS and I-JSON-safe numeric rules, cross-object identity and contract-reference closure, digest equality, deterministic delta expansion, recursive referenced-artifact validation, exact catalog/set comparison, summary/count agreement, lifecycle linkage and static routine-effect verification are mandatory verifier responsibilities.
$comment: The normative verifier invariants are in docs/specs/omnitwin-foundry-activation-v1-catalog-manifest-format.md, section 1, Mandatory semantic verification. A JSON Schema pass alone MUST NOT authorize activation. The trusted bootstrap caller MUST obtain the verifier identity/digest pin independently of this manifest and compare the fetched implementation to that external pin before execution. Before object conversion, candidate and recursively referenced catalog JSON bytes MUST pass the strict UTF-8/no-BOM/no-trailing-bytes/no-duplicate-members/no-invalid-Unicode gate and RFC 8785 re-encode byte equality. Before any lossy numeric coercion or JCS hashing, the verifier MUST reject every integer-valued JSON number outside [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991] and every numeric token that does not parse to a finite IEEE-754 binary64 value under RFC 8785.

manifestSha256.description: RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 of the complete object with this one leaf omitted.

catalogIdentifier.description: ASCII PostgreSQL catalog identifier used only for pinned external or internally generated objects whose canonical catalog spelling may contain upper-case characters.

name.description: Canonical PostgreSQL operator spelling; operator symbols are not SQL identifiers. The verifier resolves the schema-qualified operator and its operand types.

path.description: Normalized repository-relative POSIX path: no drive prefix, leading slash, backslash, control character, empty/trailing segment, or dot/dot-dot segment. The verifier resolves canonical targets through symlinks, junctions and reparse points and requires containment beneath the canonical approved root, or rejects linked traversal entirely.

sourceSet.description: Required content-addressed source closure. An authenticated bootstrap/review policy independently supplies the semantic-verifier identity and digest pin. The trusted caller checks logical sourceId/path uniqueness, exact required-source membership, bytes, media type, each artifact digest and sourceSetSha256, requires semantic_verifier_source to match both that external pin and the semantic_verifier_implementation contract before execution, and never trusts a verifier chosen only by this manifest; mutable artifact hashes are carried only by manifest instances.

artifacts.description: Catalog-set array sorted by sourceId under the normative unsigned UTF-8 verifier rule.

sourceSetSha256.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 UTF-8 bytes for this sourceSet object after omitting exactly the sourceSetSha256 member. No domain separator, salt or textual sha256: prefix is part of the preimage; the result is lower-case hex prefixed by sha256:.

collisionRules.description: Exact ordered V1 collision-policy set; no protection may be omitted or reordered.

deltaOperations.description: Semantic-order array: positions and ordinal fields must agree and be contiguous under verifier rules.

expandedCatalogSha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete expandedCatalog object's RFC 8785 UTF-8 bytes, with no member omitted; identical to expectedCatalog.catalogSha256.

v1ManagedRowsAreSentinelOnly.description: When true, the 30 managed V1 tables contain exactly one row in total: the immutable relation-1 generation-1 bootstrap disabled_sentinel whose action_sequence equals the sole action sequence start; the other 29 managed tables contain zero rows. This is not a claim that the PostgreSQL database or projected external relations are empty.

profiles.description: Closed lifecycle policy. The managed bootstrap role remains NOLOGIN/NOINHERIT in every profile. The mandatory verifier links these flags to the ephemeral external deployment LOGIN's presence/attributes, membership.lifecycle, grant.lifecycle and bootstrap_entry_point ACLs in the same profile.

lifecycle.description: bootstrap_only grants are structurally limited to bootstrap_open; the mandatory verifier derives and checks this classification from the target routine/object and principal.

anyOf.description: Explicit raw aclitem strings sorted by unsigned UTF-8 bytes; null remains distinct from an explicit empty array.

effectiveGrants.description: Normalized grant rows sorted by (grantor, grantee, privilege, grantable) within this raw ACL object; the verifier also checks each row's profile and object identity against its container.

lifecycle.description: bootstrap_only membership rows are permitted only in bootstrap_open; the mandatory verifier cross-resolves role and member classifications.

comparison.description: Activation V1 always observes its sole action sequence; an unreadable state fails closed.

isCalled.description: The action sequence is never reset to an uncalled state; false is reset/reuse evidence in every lifecycle profile.
The exact migration-installed relation-1 disabled_sentinel consumes the sequence start before either pre-bootstrap profile is observed.

effectStepOrdinal.description: Ordinal of the consumer routine's matching sequence_allocation effect step; the mandatory verifier proves that all root-first locks precede it.
The migration seed is not a routine effect. Exactly one installation_seed allocation is required for the relation-1 generation-1 bootstrap disabled_sentinel.

increment.description: Activation V1 allocation is strictly increasing; zero and negative increments are forbidden.

referencedColumns.description: Semantic-order array aligned positionally with the local foreign-key columns.

anyOf.description: Exact PG16 confdelsetcols projection by local column name; null means no subset list, including the all-referencing-columns SET NULL/DEFAULT form.

columns.description: Semantic-order local-column array; expression-only constraints use an empty array. Exclusion constraints preserve legal repeated key columns by position.

exclusionOperators.description: Semantic-order operator array aligned with exclusion keys; repeated operators are preserved by position.

keys.description: Semantic-order array preserving every PostgreSQL index key position, including repeated columns or expressions when present.

relationKind.description: Activation V1 manages exactly 30 ordinary heap tables; partitioned and foreign relations are outside this manifest set.

columns.description: Semantic-order array sorted by attnum; the verifier enforces contiguous order and name uniqueness.

constraints.description: Catalog-set array sorted by constraint identifier.

indexes.description: Catalog-set array sorted by index identifier.

triggers.description: Catalog-set array sorted by trigger identifier.

policies.description: Catalog-set array sorted by policy identifier.

outColumns.description: Semantic-order array sorted by declared OUT-column ordinal.

sha256.description: Mandatory verifier: digest of the exact UTF-8 body string.
Mandatory verifier: must equal artifact.sha256 after exact-byte retrieval.

orderedSteps.description: Unified semantic-order lock/sequence array. The mandatory verifier enforces contiguous ordinals, exact correspondence with usesSequences and sequence allocations, and that every sequence_allocation follows every applicable rootFirst lock.

semanticOperationSteps.description: Closed branch-sensitive semantic operation projection. The mandatory verifier requires selector uniqueness; collision-free operation namespaces with contiguous ordinals inside each namespace; closed unique guardIdentifiers; exact (contract ID, operation namespace, operation ordinal, branch) coverage; per-branch applicability, AST, access, aggregate-effect, write, return and continuation/return/error outcome equality; and rejection of any flat union substituted for branch effects. Guard IDs are matched by (contract ID, operation namespace, operation ordinal, guard ID) and may repeat across distinct operations. Routines with no referenced semantic-operation contract use an empty array.

arguments.description: Semantic-order array sorted by declared argument ordinal.

language.description: The closed managed activation V1 language set; extension-member C/binary routines are projected separately.

normalizedGrants.description: Catalog-set array sorted by (grantor, grantee, privilege, grantable).

dependencies.description: Catalog-set array sorted by (dependent kind/identity, referenced kind/identity, dependency type).

expandedCatalog.description: Fully expanded final catalog. The mandatory verifier checks stable-key uniqueness, exact set equality with inventoryScope.managedNames/managedRoles and the generated/external projections, all cross-references, and summary counts; no baseline inference is permitted.

roles.description: Catalog-set array sorted by role name.

memberships.description: Catalog-set array sorted by (profile, role, member, grantor).

schemas.description: Catalog-set array sorted by schema name.

extensions.description: Catalog-set array sorted by extension name.

sequences.description: Catalog-set array sorted by qualified sequence name.

tables.description: Catalog-set array sorted by qualified table name.

routines.description: Catalog-set array sorted by qualified name and identity arguments.

defaultAcls.description: Exactly the two global omnitwin_fdv1_owner default-ACL rows projected in each lifecycle profile, sorted by (profile, owner, schema, objectType). Per-schema routine/type rows are forbidden.

externalDependencies.description: Catalog-set array sorted by external object kind and identity. The mandatory verifier requires exact equality with inventoryScope.externalProjectionKinds and every dependency discovered from definitions/effects.

generatedDependents.description: Catalog-set array sorted by the generated-object dependency key; OIDs and OID-derived names are excluded from that key. The mandatory verifier requires row/array type coverage for every table, exact TOAST pair coverage where present, exact generated-trigger groups for each applicable constraint, and rejects extras or detached owners.

catalogSha256.description: Mandatory verifier: RFC 8785 digest of catalog and byte-equal to composition.expandedCatalogSha256.
Mandatory verifier: fetch artifact bytes, require artifact.sha256 and this digest to match the same canonical expanded catalog, then recursively validate it against schemaRef.

consumers.description: The verifier implementation is an externally pinned bootstrap tool, not a PostgreSQL catalog consumer. Its manifest linkage is verifierContractIds.

contractSet.description: Content-addressed byte-contract closure. Against an independently authenticated verifier identity/digest pin, the bootstrap caller checks contractId uniqueness, recursive artifact validation, contractSetSha256, exact verifierContractIds linkage for the semantic-verifier implementation and workload proof pair, exact-byte identity between the implementation and its source-set twin before execution, and bidirectional set equality between every non-verifier artifact consumer and every column/constraint/routine contractIds reference. The verifier implementation has no fake catalog consumer; its use is represented only by verifierContractIds plus the external pin. Manifest-internal content addressing alone cannot authorize the verifier.

artifacts.description: Catalog-set array sorted by contractId under the normative unsigned UTF-8 verifier rule.

verifierContractIds.description: Contract IDs of the content-addressed semantic-verifier implementation and the workload-inclusion proof Markdown/JSON Schema pair. The bootstrap caller requires exact kind/ID equality, requires the implementation identity/digest to match an authenticated pin obtained independently of the manifest, and validates all three before catalog acceptance.

contractSetSha256.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 UTF-8 bytes for this contractSet object after omitting exactly the contractSetSha256 member. No domain separator, salt or textual sha256: prefix is part of the preimage; the result is lower-case hex prefixed by sha256:.

frozenCursorRows.description: Frozen cursor intent/summary only. These four rows do not constitute executable SQL predicates or positive implementation authority; WD-B-008 requires the exact executable predicates and their live-catalog/vector proof.

negativeAssertions.description: Declarations of mandatory verifier checks, not self-authenticating evidence. Acceptance requires executing every assertion against the recursively resolved expected catalog and live PostgreSQL 16 catalogs.

rejectManagedOrLoginPerDatabaseRoleSetti.description: The mandatory verifier proves zero pg_db_role_setting rows for every managed role and projected external service/deployment LOGIN in every applicable database/profile.

rejectManagedTableRewriteInheritanceOrLo.description: The mandatory live-catalog verifier rejects user DML rewrite rules, inheritance edges in either direction, publication exposure through direct/all-table/schema publication, and subscription targeting for every managed table.

rejectUnmodeledReverseDependenciesOnMana.description: The mandatory verifier computes exact reverse-dependency closure for every managed table, column, routine and type and rejects every unmodeled external view, materialized view, rule, FK, generated expression, trigger or other dependent regardless of name/prefix.

rejectLifecycleManagedRowOrSequenceCoher.description: The mandatory verifier proves that each sentinel-only profile has exactly the one relation-1 generation-1 bootstrap disabled_sentinel and no other managed row; that its action_sequence, canonical actionSequence leaf, sequence start and observed lastValue all equal 1 with isCalled true; that exactly one installation_seed allocation names that row; and that no reset, regression, reuse or incoherent next runtime value is possible. Steady state also requires isCalled true, global uniqueness across all 30 stored action/admission-sequence columns, and max(stored value) <= lastValue.

rejectSequenceDefinitionAllocationAclOrS.description: Reject any sequence-definition drift, action/admission column default, non-explicit-nextval allocation, setval/restart/literal/copy path, privilege beyond the owner USAGE-only ACL, or cross-table stored-value collision.

rejectPgcryptoMemberOrExecutionSurfaceDr.description: Reject a missing or changed approved pgcrypto member, binary/symbol/property/extension-dependency drift, PUBLIC or service/capability execution, owner execution of another extension-schema routine, or a caller-selected digest algorithm.

rejectDefaultPrivilegeCreatorOrScopeDrif.description: Reject per-schema-only routine/type default hardening, missing global owner rows, unexpected PUBLIC defaults, or creation under an unmodeled current_role followed only by an owner transfer.

rejectProviderResultEffectArmDrift.description: Reject a missing, extra or reordered provider-result admission operation or record branch; flat union in place of exact operation/branch effects; wrong semantic selector, AST, relation/access, guard array, clock, namespace-plus-ordinal continuation target, outcome, write or return source; incomplete admission-materialized 0053 graph; changed frozen R27 branch/terminal owner or later-different-only terminal-conflict route; missing pre-root identity/catalog/builtin effect; incomplete R5-pinned caller/provider-signer recursive lineage; expanded historical-result exception; allocation outside admission R27 then conditional R24/R22 or first-terminal record R29; or replay, SQLSTATE, sequence-source or time-source drift.

rejectProviderResultSameCallerKeyDiffere.description: For the same authenticated recovery caller and API idempotency key, reject a different executionId because the exact scalar-only SQL-derived API request wrapper produces a different sql_derived_api_request_sha256; the result is 23505 with no mutation.

rejectProviderResultReplayContainmentClo.description: Reject later-different replay when its current-evidence/ledger-linked R24 or the R24-sourced R22 execution/attempt/fence/phase closure is missing, mismatched or unlocked; no containment identifier is returned.

rejectProviderResultCommandReservationCo.description: Reject every fdv1_result_* provider-command reservation column, reservation constraint/index/guard, or accepted-provider-result design that depends on a command reservation rather than the complete same-transaction R27/0053 graph.

rejectDelayedProviderResult0053Materiali.description: Reject an accepted provider-result R27 whose exact observation, command completion/projection, completion event and classification graph is missing at admission commit, or any later routine that creates or mutates that graph.

rejectRecordTimeProviderResultContainmen.description: Reject R24 or R22 allocation/insertion by fdv1_api_record_provider_result; later-different containment must already exist from the same evidence-admission transaction in exact R27 then R24 then R22 sequence order.

rejectPreR29ProviderStopForFrozenTermina.description: Reject pre_submit_deny or provider_stop once a frozen first-terminal owner R27 plus its complete 0053 graph exists, even before R29; that pre-R29 phase is exactly post_terminal_broker_deny and later R29 insertion cannot reopen output.

rejectWatchdogCursorNoDueOrCorruptionDri.description: Reject any open attempt/fence graph that does not match exactly one frozen watchdog cursor row, any due obligation after a closed terminal/custody/containment boundary, or any corruption state silently treated as no-due.

rejectWatchdogUncatalogedPassiveAuthorit.description: Reject any passive authority member not present with exact phase, substage, relation, key, row-SHA, horizon and consumption semantics in the future closed member catalog.

rejectWatchdogMaterializedAuthorityHoriz.description: Reject treating a materialized authority_not_after recomputation assertion as an independent passive authority member.

rejectWatchdogPassiveConsumptionDrift.description: Reject a consumed authority retained as active, an unconsumed authority omitted, an empty synthetic envelope, or a phase/substage consumption predicate that differs from the closed catalog.

rejectWatchdogScheduledSourceSubarmOrImm.description: Reject an uncataloged scheduled policy/epoch/revocation subarm, ambiguous source identity/SHA/due time, or any immediate revocation, compromise, kill or security source incorrectly deferred to watchdog repair.

rejectWatchdogSyntheticExpiryShapeSortOr.description: Reject synthetic-expiry member/object shape, canonical key, C-collation/JCS ordering, domain digest, source ID or duplicate-member drift.

rejectWatchdogClockOrderOrClockRoleDrift.description: Reject a cutoff sampled before the global root lock, cutoff used as mutation time, mutation time sampled before selected locks, exclusive due equality, or scan_cutoff_at later than receipt recorded_at.

rejectWatchdogWinnerLimitOrSkipLockedDri.description: Reject changed per-attempt/global winner ordering, more than one winner per attempt/fence/phase, source-row rather than obligation counting, limit drift, or any SKIP LOCKED path.

rejectWatchdogSatisfiedObligationRescan.description: Reject initial selection of an already completely satisfied exact obligation or conflict_count used for anything other than a final-lock exact-race reread.

rejectWatchdogHistoricalCallerValidation.description: Reject validating an existing closure against the current scanner instead of its stored caller authorization and that authorization's validity at the original receipt time.

rejectWatchdogClosureStopOrSourceEvidenc.description: Reject a containment whose exact source-evidence binding, phase effect, target state, source receipt correlation, or required/forbidden existing or new stop closure differs.

rejectWatchdogCallerSelectedDerivedFacts.description: Reject any watchdog input that selects activation, execution, attempt, fence, actor, terminal state, priority, phase effect, source digest or stop digest rather than deriving it from locked authority.

rejectWatchdogVectorCoverageDrift.description: Reject positive watchdog readiness until every read, lock, write, call, sequence allocation, scheduled-source arm, passive-member arm and nested closure effect maps exactly to the expanded catalog and live routine.
